m2_law.rule: moving p_r: lag to p* capped by the valve flow; retract meter-in A_ann |u|, extend meter-out b_T A_h |u| sqrt((p_r - p_T) / dp_c); C_r = A_ann^2 (1/k_r + 1/k_h), B hose not included; M2 reads p_hat = p_r + Delta w, Delta = p_r0 - p_r,rel at the release, w = base release decay (revision 4); extension lock anchor p_r0 = max(p_ext + max(p_tr - p*, 0), p_floor), p_tr = moving rod pressure before the lock, p* = extension target; retract lock keeps p_ret (revision 5)
